title: Circuit Solver Result
description: Result from CircuitSolver.solve() for a single frequency point

frequency.description: Frequency in Hz at which the circuit was solved

nodeVoltages.description: Map of node IDs to complex voltage values. Each node ID is a string in format 'componentId_terminalIndex'. Values are complex numbers with 're' and 'im' properties.

sourceCurrents.description: Map of voltage source component IDs to complex current values. Values are complex numbers with 're' and 'im' properties.

complexNumber.description: Complex number representation with real and imaginary parts
